title: THE FESTIVAL OF TWO GRAVITIES
deck: Two communities share one memorial chamber and opposite ideas of down. At the same hour, each must name its dead in the gravity they called home—but their simultaneous rites will tear the common axle apart. Illuminara can hold the structure for minutes. She cannot decide whose memory moves first.
shape: Seven scenes across one emergency morning: Illuminara learns two complete gravity-bound memorial rites, discovers that their opposed loads can turn the shared chamber, accepts responsibility for a failed shortened test, and helps the communities choose one half-turn between true directions. Vale begins freely; Orra follows intact; outside refusals, the cracked seam and separate brake keys keep the success real rather than total.

scenes.title: The Axle Keeps the Hour
paragraphs: *The Turnhouse, Mera Ring · 08:04 · joint naming begins at 09:20*

The memorial chamber hung around a black axle broad enough for six people to embrace. On one side, the people of Orra had stacked iron name-discs in low stone trays. On the other, the displaced people of Vale had suspended blue glass bells from white cords. Every disc and every bell carried a dead person's name.
Between the two preparations, a red heat line climbed the axle housing one finger at a time.

**Jori Nemet**  
If both climaxes land together, the inner collar tears through the east wall.

**Teren Oss**  
The Orra rite has reached the ninth morning on this date for one hundred and twelve years. We do not move our dead because Vale chose the same hour.

**Sela Varo**  
Vale did not choose it. The resettlement council assigned us the only hour when our bodies could still face home. Then Orra expanded its closing procession until the hours met.

**Teren Oss**  
My granddaughter is on this tray. Do not turn this into a quarrel over a timetable.

**Sela Varo**  
My mother is in the third bell. We were displaced; our dead were not rescheduled.

**Jori Nemet**  
The full naming needs twenty-seven minutes. Under the first ceremonial load, the old collar gives us seventeen. If a test heats the repair collar, we have nineteen minutes to brace it before it softens.

**Teren Oss**  
Then Vale can begin after us.

**Sela Varo**  
We have begun after you for thirty-six years.

Jori pointed to the maintenance diagram. Unloaded, the motor could face the empty chamber either home-down. Under ceremonial weight it locked out. Only the opposed bell-belts and stone trays could move the room, and Jori could not yet see how to use them without choosing an order.

**Illuminara**  
I will not choose an order before I know what the order means. Show me both rites without shortening them. Jori, can the chamber carry one rehearsal at a time?

**Jori Nemet**  
If you damp the axle while I reset the collar, yes—long enough for one complete rite each.

**Illuminara**  
Then I can keep the chamber standing long enough to listen. I cannot make either council consent, and I will not use strength to decide which dead come first.

scenes.title: The Weight of Orra
paragraphs: *The stoneward side · 08:13 · sixty-seven minutes to the joint naming*
Orra’s mourners stepped onto the dark floor in groups of four, each holding an iron name-disc to the breastbone. At the first drumbeat they leaned ring-down; at the second, they spoke.

**Teren Oss**  
Hessa Pell, who kept the pressure doors open at North Spoke.

**Orra mourners**  
Weight held you. We keep your weight.
They placed the disc in the axle tray. After every fourth name, the mourners held three breaths while the iron settled. A child then touched it and repeated the name without title or deed.
Illuminara braced the damaged collar without taking weight from the mourners. When Teren reached Lio’s disc, his voice changed.

**Teren Oss**  
Lio Oss, who climbed the outer vanes because the emergency motor would not answer.
The mourners answered. Teren did not. Nemi touched the disc.

**Nemi**  
Lio.

**Teren Oss**  
My granddaughter. She was seventeen. We lengthened the rite after the vane failure left sixty-three names with no place in it.

**Illuminara**  
And if Orra yields the first movement?

**Teren Oss**  
Then the room turns away before we say where they died. Gravity was the last thing holding Lio. We lean into it because she did. We keep faith with the direction that took her weight.
At the rehearsal’s end, Illuminara accepted a disc from Nemi and held it against her breastbone in Vale’s opposite pull. The metal tugged sideways.

**Nemi**  
That is wrong gravity.

**Illuminara**  
Yes. I wanted to know how wrong feels before I ask anyone to stand in it.
Teren watched her return the disc. The heat line reached its first warning mark.

scenes.title: The Direction Vale Lost
paragraphs: *The skyward side · 08:39 · forty-one minutes to the joint naming*

Vale's people clipped broad belts to the white cords. Their old home had been the inverse quarter of Mera Ring before a bearing collapse made it uninhabitable. For them, home-down had once pointed toward what was now the Turnhouse ceiling.

At Sela's signal, the mourners leaned into the belts until their heels left the floor. They raised the blue bells above their faces. Each bell held one drop of water sealed inside it. When the drop struck the glass, they named someone who had died during the evacuation.

**Sela Varo**  
Eran Vale, who gave his place in the last descent cage.

**Vale mourners**  
You fell beyond our ground. We turn our faces after you.
The drop crossed the bell and rang against the opposite wall.

Vale held seven breaths after every third name. During those breaths, one mourner crossed to another and checked the belt buckle. No person was supposed to remember alone or hang from an unwitnessed cord.

**Sela Varo**  
My mother. The relocation office registered her as arriving because her identity band reached the new quarter. Her body did not.

**Illuminara**  
What does the first movement mean?

**Sela Varo**  
It means we are not guests borrowing Orra's floor. Once, every public rite began with us standing wrong-way and waiting for their important business to finish. We were told gratitude should make waiting easy. Giving us the first turn now would not repay that. It would only stop repeating it.

**Illuminara**  
And if Orra accepts Vale first, may Orra keep its words and three-breath pauses when its turn comes?

**Sela Varo**  
Yes. I do not want Lio Oss renamed. I want Aven Varo named where her body knew down.

**Elder Iven**  
I will not enter a chamber that turns our dead into half of a machine. I will keep the skyward naming outside, even if Sela agrees to this.

**Sela Varo**  
You may. No Vale name will be removed from the outside rite because its keeper refuses the shared one.

**Elder Mora**  
Then I claim the same freedom. I will keep stoneward naming outside. My son does not need a turning room.

Illuminara clipped herself into a Vale belt while the room remained Orra-down. Aven's sealed drop lay against the wrong wall. She set an unused iron disc sideways on the transparent mechanics sheet and pulled the bell cord. The disc rolled; the drop rose. Neither load had won, yet together they made a turning moment around the axle.

**Nemi**  
They are pulling different ways.

**Illuminara**  
Yes. Not cancelling. Composing.
Jori laid the maintenance diagram over the paths she had made. The same couple crossed the collar. He added the drum and one common counterweight tray.

**Jori Nemet**  
It works. Preset the empty chamber Vale-down. Vale names while its belts store lift. On each last breath, Orra adds one measured disc to the common tray. Release both after Vale’s last name: one half-turn to Orra-down, then Orra names.

**Teren Oss**  
A machine that orders us is still a machine that orders us.

**Illuminara**  
Then the mechanics decide nothing. We test whether the loads can turn. Vale and Orra decide whether either rite enters the machine, which rite begins, and who may leave.

scenes.title: The Broken Measure
paragraphs: *The central collar · 08:54 · twenty-six minutes to the joint naming*

Jori proposed a narrow coupling test: three Vale belts would wind the drum, three Orra discs would load the counterweight, and the release would move an empty practice frame. It would not turn the chamber or speak a memorial name.

**Sela Varo**  
Our belts need seven breaths to settle. Your sheet gives us three.

**Teren Oss**  
And it puts Vale on the winding side as if the order were settled.
The red line stood one mark below the repair threshold. A full-pause test would consume the time needed to brace the collar before the public naming.

**Illuminara**  
You are both right. The sheet proves the forces compose. Only the live collar can tell us whether a real belt settles before the counterweight takes it, and which face of the damaged tooth receives the hand-off. A shortened test risks that tooth; it certifies no rite and settles no order.

**Jori Nemet**  
One load alone cannot answer either question.

**Illuminara**  
I recommend the shortened test for those two answers. If the tooth breaks, the judgment is mine with yours—not Jori’s burden alone.
Sela required no memorial names and a Vale stop right; Teren required the same for Orra and no implied order. They chalked both limits beside the brakes.

The first Vale belt wound cleanly. The first Orra disc drew the practice frame toward the release. On the second Vale pull, the shortened pause left the cord oscillating. Jori called hold. Sela reached for the brake as the counterweight arrived.
The inner collar snapped one tooth.

Illuminara caught the axle before it rolled through the east wall. The force drove her boots through the floor tiles. Bells struck cords, iron discs leapt in their trays, and a blue memorial panel split from top to bottom.
The panel carried the eighteen Vale names whose bodies had never been recovered. Sela pressed both hands to the crack. The letters remained legible.

**Illuminara**  
I asked for the shortened test. Responsibility begins with my recommendation. No one will record this as Vale moving too slowly.

**Jori Nemet**  
The break answered us. The counterweight struck while the second belt still oscillated; the shock crossed the already damaged face. Vale needs all seven breaths, and its drum must take the unbroken face first. We have nineteen minutes to seat a cooling wedge. If it seats, the collar gives forty minutes under full load.

**Teren Oss**  
Restore all seven Vale breaths. If the collar cannot bear the full rite, it cannot bear a shared one.

**Sela Varo**  
And Orra keeps its three breaths and true ring-down.
Illuminara held the axle while Sela read the eighteen cracked names and Teren listened. Equal seconds had proved unequal in respect and in load.

scenes.title: Who Turns First
paragraphs: *Between the two doors · 09:04 · first cooling wedge due by 09:15*
Jori touched the bright break mark. Seven breaths would let each Vale belt settle; Vale-first would put its stored pull on the unbroken face before Orra’s common tray took the hand-off.

**Jori Nemet**  
That is what the break taught us. It tells us what the axle can survive, not what anyone must consent to.

**Sela Varo**  
I will not let a broken tooth be the first authority that finds a use for us.

**Illuminara**  
Then tell him why Vale asks to begin when usefulness is removed.

**Sela Varo**  
For thirty-six years our children watched adults face a home the public chamber would not face. They learned our dead came after the official dead. Beginning once will not repay that. It will let our children see home-down enter this room without borrowing another grief's permission.

**Teren Oss**  
If I accept, some of Orra will say I turned Lio away from the direction that killed her.

**Sela Varo**  
Not during our names. We finish in Vale-down. Then I put my hand on Lio's tray while the room turns. You speak her name only after Orra-down is under us.

**Teren Oss**  
Why should you touch her disc?

**Sela Varo**  
Because you listened to the eighteen. Shared does not mean mixed. It means neither grief lets the other's bodies fall during the change.

**Illuminara**  
Teren, Orra may keep its full rite outside with Mora. If you stay, Vale begins by your choice, with all seven breaths. I can arrest a failed turn for less than a minute. I may save the people and lose the room.

**Teren Oss**  
No promise that grief becomes friendship?

**Illuminara**  
No. Only a testable promise: each rite remains whole, and each community carries the other safely between directions.

Teren accepted Vale-first for this chamber today and gave Sela authority to stop a shortened Vale pause. Sela accepted Orra’s complete naming after the turn and gave Teren authority to stop an unwitnessed belt. Both kept the right to leave.
The signatures did not bind Elder Iven or Elder Mora. Their outside rites were already gathering.

At 09:14, apprentices pressed the first cooling wedge while Illuminara held the collar square. It seated: forty minutes under full load for a twenty-seven-minute rite. Jori carried the second wedge to the midpoint latch.
The chamber doors opened. People chose where to stand.

scenes.title: The Festival of Two Gravities
paragraphs: *The shared chamber · 09:20 · first wedge seated; midpoint wedge pending*

The empty room had been motored Vale-down. Vale entered with blue bells, their drops resting where home said down. The belts that had lifted mourners in wrong gravity now held the drum’s stored pull beneath their feet. Orra waited with hands on the first unloaded tray. Illuminara crouched beneath the wounded collar; Jori held the second wedge; Teren and Sela held separate brakes.

**Sela Varo**  
Eran Vale, who gave his place in the last descent cage.

**Vale mourners**  
You fell beyond our ground. We turn our faces after you.
Three names. Seven breaths. On the last breath, after the belt stopped trembling, Orra added one measured disc to the common tray without speaking. Each blue drop rang against the proper wall.
At the cracked panel, Sela spoke all eighteen unrecovered names. Teren kept one hand on the brake and one against the glass so its halves would not chatter.
After the last Vale name, Jori released the coupled loads. The chamber began its single half-turn. Floor and ceiling ceased to be honest words.

For four seconds, drops floated in the centers of bells and iron discs rose a finger above their trays. Nemi laughed. Illuminara felt an answering delight—sudden, bodily and impossible to mistake for disrespect. Teren laughed too.
Sela caught Lio's tray as Orra gravity gathered beneath them. Two Vale mourners held it with her. Teren released his brake only after every belt showed green.

**Teren Oss**  
Hessa Pell, who kept the pressure doors open at North Spoke.

**Orra mourners**  
Weight held you. We keep your weight.
Four names. Three breaths. During each pause, Vale witnesses checked the cords in silence.

**Teren Oss**  
Lio Oss, who climbed the outer vanes because the emergency motor would not answer.

**Orra mourners**  
Weight held you. We keep your weight.

**Nemi**  
Lio.
The name crossed the chamber in Lio's true direction. Sela kept her hand on the tray until it stopped trembling.
At the midpoint latch, the second wedge skidded against the missing tooth.

**Jori Nemet**  
Stillness for two breaths.
Teren closed his brake. Sela called every Vale witness to hold. Illuminara took the torsion through her shoulder. Jori reversed the wedge, struck once and locked it. The heat line stopped.
Outside, Mora's stone drum and Iven's sky bell answered from separate courtyards. Their rites continued without condemnation from inside.

The last Orra name was spoken at 09:47. Every shared name had been spoken once, in its own community's true orientation. During the half-turn, the other community's hands had carried its bells or trays safely into the next direction.

scenes.title: What the Chamber Keeps
paragraphs: *The Turnhouse courtyards · 10:31 · the axle cooling*
The chamber closed for repair, but its walls had not torn. The cracked panel lay between padded braces with all eighteen names legible.

**Sela Varo**  
Leave the seam.

**Teren Oss**  
Mark why it cracked—and who objected before the test.

**Jori Nemet**  
I will.
The repair charter gave each community its own load controls and stop brake. Neither key could turn the chamber alone. It fixed no order for next year and could not prevent either outside rite.

Across the courtyard, Iven poured his bell water into a planter. Mora set her son's disc in a stone niche. They had refused the shared chamber and kept their rites. Each later sent one apprentice to Jori's axle class; neither endorsed the festival.
Nemi and two Vale children threaded cords through a wooden collar. When they pulled at once, it jammed. When they listened for the pauses, it turned.

**Nemi**  
It is not the same song.

**Vale child**  
It is not supposed to be.
They turned it again. Vale had begun without being assigned last. Orra had named its dead in true ring-down. The argument remained, the seam remained, and the common axle remained.
Jori locked the two brake keys into separate boxes and gave one to Sela and one to Teren.

critic_line: Two communities who each needed the other's hour to be the wrong one learned that the room could turn if their pulls were composed rather than ranked, and Illuminara, who had held an Orra disc in Vale's gravity to learn how wrong feels, owned the shortened test that cracked the tooth and the panel, so Teren chose to let Vale begin, Sela put a hand on Lio's tray through the turn, and two keys went into two boxes.

shared_strengths: Humane, dialogue-heavy conflict between two grieving communities, with a vivid central image and a fair resolution that keeps the dissenters' dignity. Held back by dense technical and timing detail, a stiff procedural tone, and a tidy ending that makes the stakes feel a little managed.

The two rites are emotionally specific, and the half-turn converts abstract coexistence into memorable physical action. Dialogue grants both communities agency, resistance and dignity. Dense mechanical explanation and many names may slow some readers, but the failed test, freely chosen compromise and imperfect aftermath make the humane resolution feel earned.
shared_reservations: Jori Nemet: The full naming needs twenty-seven minutes. Under the first ceremonial load, the old collar gives us seventeen. If a test heats the repair collar, we have nineteen minutes to brace it before it softens.
Only the opposed bell-belts and stone trays could move the room, and Jori could not yet see how to use them without choosing an order.

translation_sl.title: PRAZNIK DVEH TEŽNOSTI
translation_sl.deck: Dve skupnosti si delita eno spominsko dvorano in nasprotni predstavi o tem, kje je spodaj. Ob isti uri mora vsaka imenovati svoje mrtve v težnosti, ki so ji rekli dom — toda njuna sočasna obreda bosta raztrgala skupno os. Illuminara lahko konstrukcijo zadrži nekaj minut. Ne more pa odločiti, čigav spomin se premakne prvi.
translation_sl.shape: Sedem prizorov v enem izrednem jutru: Illuminara spozna dva popolna, na težnost vezana spominska obreda, odkrije, da lahko njuni nasprotni obremenitvi zavrtita skupno dvorano, prevzame odgovornost za neuspešen skrajšani preizkus in pomaga skupnostma izbrati en polobrat med resničnima smerema. Vale začne po svobodni izbiri; Orra sledi z nedotaknjenim obredom; zunanji zavrnitvi, razpoka in ločena ključa zavor ohranijo uspeh resničen, ne pa popoln.

scenes.title: Os drži uro
paragraphs: *Hiša obrata, obroč Mera · 08:04 · skupno imenovanje se začne ob 09:20*

Spominska dvorana je visela okoli črne osi, dovolj široke, da bi jo objelo šest ljudi. Na eni strani so ljudje Orre zložili železne imenske diske v nizke kamnite pladnje. Na drugi so razseljeni ljudje Valeja obesili modre steklene zvonove na bele vrvi. Vsak disk in vsak zvon je nosil ime umrlega človeka.
Med pripravama se je po ohišju osi za prst naenkrat vzpenjala rdeča toplotna črta.

**Jori Nemet**  
Če oba vrhunca nastopita hkrati, notranji obroč prebije vzhodno steno.

**Teren Oss**  
Orrin obred je na ta datum dosegel deveto jutro že sto dvanajst let zapored. Svojih mrtvih ne bomo premikali zato, ker je Vale izbral isto uro.

**Sela Varo**  
Vale je ni izbral. Svet za preselitev nam je dodelil edino uro, ko so bila naša telesa še lahko obrnjena proti domu. Potem je Orra podaljševala sklepni sprevod, dokler se uri nista srečali.

**Teren Oss**  
Moja vnukinja je na tem pladnju. Ne spreminjajte tega v prepir o urniku.

**Sela Varo**  
Moja mati je v tretjem zvonu. Mi smo bili razseljeni; naši mrtvi niso dobili novega termina.

**Jori Nemet**  
Celotno imenovanje traja sedemindvajset minut. Pod prvo obredno obremenitvijo nam stari obroč da sedemnajst minut. Če preizkus segreje popravljeni obroč, imamo devetnajst minut, da ga podpremo, preden se zmehča.

**Teren Oss**  
Potem lahko Vale začne za nami.

**Sela Varo**  
Za vami začenjamo že šestintrideset let.

Jori je pokazal na vzdrževalni načrt. Neobremenjen motor je lahko prazno dvorano obrnil v katerokoli smer domačega navzdol. Pod obredno težo se je zaklenil. Prostor so lahko premaknili le nasprotno vlečeni pasovi zvonov in kamniti pladnji, Jori pa še ni videl, kako bi jih uporabil, ne da bi izbral vrstni red.

**Illuminara**  
Vrstnega reda ne bom izbrala, preden razumem, kaj pomeni. Pokažite mi oba obreda brez krajšanja. Jori, ali lahko dvorana prenese po eno vajo naenkrat?

**Jori Nemet**  
Če med ponastavljanjem obroča dušite os, da — dovolj dolgo za po en celoten obred vsake skupnosti.

**Illuminara**  
Potem lahko dvorano držim pokonci dovolj dolgo, da prisluhnem. Nobenega sveta ne morem prisiliti v soglasje in moči ne bom uporabila za odločitev, kateri mrtvi pridejo prvi.

scenes.title: Teža Orre
paragraphs: *Kamnita stran · 08:13 · sedeminšestdeset minut do skupnega imenovanja*
Orrini žalujoči so stopili na temna tla v skupinah po štiri; vsak je držal železen imenski disk ob prsnici. Ob prvem udarcu bobna so se nagnili navzdol proti obroču; ob drugem so spregovorili.

**Teren Oss**  
Hessa Pell, ki je držala tlačna vrata Severnega kraka odprta.

**Orrini žalujoči**  
Teža te je držala. Mi ohranjamo tvojo težo.
Disk so položili v pladenj ob osi. Po vsakem četrtem imenu so žalujoči zadržali tri vdihe, medtem ko se je železo poleglo. Nato se ga je dotaknil otrok in ponovil ime brez naziva ali dejanja.
Illuminara je podprla poškodovani obroč, ne da bi žalujočim odvzela težo. Ko je Teren prišel do Lioinega diska, se mu je glas spremenil.

**Teren Oss**  
Lio Oss, ki je splezala na zunanje lopatice, ker se zasilni motor ni odzval.
Žalujoči so odgovorili. Teren ni. Nemi se je dotaknila diska.

**Nemi**  
Lio.

**Teren Oss**  
Moja vnukinja. Imela je sedemnajst let. Obred smo podaljšali, potem ko je okvara lopatice pustila triinšestdeset imen brez mesta v njem.

**Illuminara**  
In če Orra prepusti prvi premik?

**Teren Oss**  
Potem se prostor obrne stran, preden povemo, kje so umrli. Težnost je bila zadnja stvar, ki je držala Lio. Vanjo se nagnemo, ker se je tudi ona. Ostajamo zvesti smeri, ki je prevzela njeno težo.
Ob koncu vaje je Illuminara sprejela disk od Nemi in ga v nasprotni vleki Valeja pridržala ob prsnici. Kovina jo je vlekla vstran.

**Nemi**  
To je napačna težnost.

**Illuminara**  
Da. Preden koga prosim, naj stoji v njej, sem želela občutiti, kako napačna je.
Teren jo je opazoval, ko je vrnila disk. Toplotna črta je dosegla prvo opozorilno oznako.

scenes.title: Smer, ki jo je Vale izgubil
paragraphs: *Nebesna stran · 08:39 · enainštirideset minut do skupnega imenovanja*

Ljudje Valeja so na bele vrvi pripeli široke pasove. Njihov stari dom je bil v nasprotni četrtini obroča Mera, preden ga je porušitev ležaja naredila neprimernega za bivanje. Zanje je domače navzdol nekoč kazalo proti temu, kar je bilo zdaj strop Hiše obrata.

Na Selin znak so se žalujoči nagnili v pasove, dokler se jim pete niso dvignile od tal. Modre zvonove so dvignili nad obraze. V vsakem zvonu je bila zapečatena ena kaplja vode. Ko je kaplja zadela steklo, so imenovali nekoga, ki je umrl med evakuacijo.

**Sela Varo**  
Eran Vale, ki je odstopil svoje mesto v zadnji spuščalni kletki.

**Valejevi žalujoči**  
Padel si onkraj naših tal. Za teboj obračamo obraze.
Kaplja je prečkala zvon in zazvonila ob nasprotno steno.
Vale je po vsakem tretjem imenu zadržal sedem vdihov. Med njimi je en žalujoči stopil k drugemu in preveril zaponko njegovega pasu. Nihče naj ne bi pomnil sam ali visel z vrvi brez priče.

**Sela Varo**  
Moja mati. Urad za preselitev jo je vpisal kot prispelo, ker je njen identifikacijski trak dosegel novo četrt. Njeno telo je ni.

**Illuminara**  
Kaj pomeni prvi premik?

**Sela Varo**  
Pomeni, da nismo gostje, ki si izposojajo Orrina tla. Nekoč se je vsak javni obred začel tako, da smo stali narobe obrnjeni in čakali, da se njihovi pomembni opravki končajo. Rekli so nam, da bi morala hvaležnost olajšati čakanje. Če bi nam zdaj dali prvi obrat, tega ne bi popravili. Le prenehali bi ponavljati isto.

**Illuminara**  
In če Orra sprejme, da Vale začne, sme Orra ohraniti svoje besede in premore treh vdihov, ko pride na vrsto?

**Sela Varo**  
Da. Ne želim, da Lio Oss dobi drugo ime. Želim, da je Aven Varo imenovana tam, kjer je njeno telo poznalo navzdol.

**Starešina Iven**  
Ne bom vstopil v dvorano, ki naše mrtve spremeni v polovico stroja. Nebesno imenovanje bom obdržal zunaj, tudi če Sela privoli v to.

**Sela Varo**  
Lahko. Nobeno Valejevo ime ne bo odstranjeno iz zunanjega obreda, ker njegov skrbnik zavrača skupnega.

**Starešina Mora**  
Potem zahtevam enako svobodo. Kamnito imenovanje bom obdržala zunaj. Moj sin ne potrebuje vrtečega se prostora.

Illuminara se je pripela v Valejev pas, medtem ko je soba ostala obrnjena navzdol po Orrino. Avenina zapečatena kaplja je ležala ob napačni steni. Na prosojni mehanski načrt je postavila neuporabljen železen disk postrani in povlekla vrv zvona. Disk se je zakotalil; kaplja se je dvignila. Nobena obremenitev ni zmagala, skupaj pa sta ustvarili vrtilni moment okoli osi.

**Nemi**  
Vlečejo v različni smeri.

**Illuminara**  
Da. Ne izničujeta se. Sestavljata se.
Jori je vzdrževalni načrt položil čez poti, ki jih je naredila. Isti par sil je prečkal obroč. Dodal je boben in en skupni pladenj protiuteži.

**Jori Nemet**  
Deluje. Prazno dvorano vnaprej nastavite navzdol po Valejevo. Vale imenuje, medtem ko njegovi pasovi shranjujejo dvig. Ob vsakem zadnjem vdihu Orra doda en izmerjen disk v skupni pladenj. Oboje sprostite po zadnjem Valejevem imenu: en polobrat navzdol po Orrino, nato imenuje Orra.

**Teren Oss**  
Stroj, ki nam določa vrstni red, je še vedno stroj, ki nam določa vrstni red.

**Illuminara**  
Potem mehanika ne odloča ničesar. Preizkusimo, ali obremenitvi lahko zavrtita prostor. Vale in Orra odločita, ali kateri od obredov sploh vstopi v stroj, kateri se začne in kdo sme oditi.

scenes.title: Zlomljena mera
paragraphs: *Osrednji obroč · 08:54 · šestindvajset minut do skupnega imenovanja*

Jori je predlagal omejen preizkus sklopitve: trije Valejevi pasovi bi navili boben, trije Orrini diski bi obremenili protiutež, sprostitev pa bi premaknila prazen vadbeni okvir. Dvorane ne bi zavrteli in ne bi izgovorili nobenega spominskega imena.

**Sela Varo**  
Naši pasovi potrebujejo sedem vdihov, da se umirijo. Vaš načrt nam daje tri.

**Teren Oss**  
In Vale postavlja na stran navijanja, kakor da je vrstni red že določen.
Rdeča črta je stala eno oznako pod pragom popravila. Preizkus s celotnimi premori bi porabil čas, potreben za podporo obroča pred javnim imenovanjem.

**Illuminara**  
Oba imata prav. Načrt dokazuje, da se sili sestavljata. Le pravi obroč nam lahko pove, ali se resnični pas umiri, preden ga prevzame protiutež, in katera stran poškodovanega zoba sprejme prenos. Skrajšani preizkus ogroža ta zob; ne potrjuje nobenega obreda in ne določa vrstnega reda.

**Jori Nemet**  
Ena sama obremenitev ne more odgovoriti na nobeno vprašanje.

**Illuminara**  
Za ta dva odgovora priporočam skrajšani preizkus. Če se zob zlomi, je presoja moja skupaj z vašo — ne samo Jorijevo breme.
Sela je zahtevala, da ni spominskih imen in da ima Vale pravico ustaviti; Teren je zahteval enako za Orro in nobenega nakazanega vrstnega reda. Obe omejitvi so s kredo zapisali ob zavorah.

Prvi Valejev pas se je gladko navil. Prvi Orrin disk je potegnil vadbeni okvir proti sprožilcu. Pri drugem Valejevem potegu je skrajšani premor pustil vrv nihati. Jori je ukazal mirovanje. Sela je segla po zavori, ko je prispela protiutež.
Notranji obroč je odlomil en zob.

Illuminara je ujela os, preden bi se zakotalila skozi vzhodno steno. Sila ji je škornje pognala skozi talne ploščice. Zvonovi so udarili ob vrvi, železni diski so poskočili v pladnjih in modra spominska plošča je počila od vrha do dna.
Plošča je nosila osemnajst Valejevih imen ljudi, katerih trupel niso nikoli našli. Sela je pritisnila obe dlani ob razpoko. Črke so ostale čitljive.

**Illuminara**  
Jaz sem zahtevala skrajšani preizkus. Odgovornost se začne z mojim priporočilom. Nihče tega ne bo zapisal kot Valejevo prepočasno premikanje.

**Jori Nemet**  
Zlom nam je odgovoril. Protiutež je udarila, ko je drugi pas še nihal; sunek je prečkal že poškodovano stran. Vale potrebuje vseh sedem vdihov, njegov boben pa mora najprej prevzeti nepoškodovana stran. Imamo devetnajst minut, da namestimo hladilno zagozdo. Če sede, bo obroč pri polni obremenitvi zdržal štirideset minut.

**Teren Oss**  
Vrnite vseh sedem Valejevih vdihov. Če obroč ne prenese celotnega obreda, ne more prenesti skupnega.

**Sela Varo**  
In Orra ohrani svoje tri vdihe ter pravo smer navzdol proti obroču.
Illuminara je držala os, medtem ko je Sela brala osemnajst razpokanih imen, Teren pa poslušal. Enake sekunde so se izkazale za neenake v spoštovanju in obremenitvi.

scenes.title: Kdo se obrne prvi
paragraphs: *Med obema vratoma · 09:04 · prva hladilna zagozda mora biti nameščena do 09:15*

Jori se je dotaknil svetle sledi zloma. Sedem vdihov bi omogočilo, da se vsak Valejev pas umiri; če bi Vale začel, bi se njegova shranjena vleka naslonila na nepoškodovano stran, preden bi Orrin skupni pladenj prevzel prenos.

**Jori Nemet**  
To nas je naučil zlom. Pove nam, kaj os lahko prenese, ne pa, v kaj mora kdorkoli privoliti.

**Sela Varo**  
Ne bom dovolila, da je zlomljeni zob prva oblast, ki v nas najde korist.

**Illuminara**  
Potem mu povejte, zakaj Vale želi začeti, ko koristnost odstranimo.

**Sela Varo**  
Šestintrideset let so naši otroci gledali odrasle, obrnjene proti domu, proti kateremu javna dvorana ni bila obrnjena. Naučili so se, da naši mrtvi pridejo za uradnimi mrtvimi. En sam začetek tega ne bo povrnil. Našim otrokom bo omogočil videti, kako domače navzdol vstopi v ta prostor, ne da bi si izprosilo dovoljenje druge žalosti.

**Teren Oss**  
Če sprejmem, bodo nekateri iz Orre rekli, da sem Lio obrnil stran od smeri, ki jo je ubila.

**Sela Varo**  
Ne med našimi imeni. Končamo v Valejevem navzdol. Potem položim roko na Lioin pladenj, medtem ko se prostor obrača. Njeno ime izgovorite šele, ko je pod nami Orrino navzdol.

**Teren Oss**  
Zakaj bi se vi dotaknili njenega diska?

**Sela Varo**  
Ker ste poslušali osemnajst imen. Skupno ne pomeni pomešano. Pomeni, da nobena žalost med spremembo ne pusti pasti teles druge.

**Illuminara**  
Teren, Orra lahko z Moro zunaj ohrani svoj celotni obred. Če ostanete, Vale po vaši izbiri začne z vsemi sedmimi vdihi. Neuspel obrat lahko ustavim za manj kot minuto. Morda rešim ljudi in izgubim prostor.

**Teren Oss**  
Brez obljube, da žalost postane prijateljstvo?

**Illuminara**  
Brez. Le preverljiva obljuba: vsak obred ostane cel, vsaka skupnost pa drugo varno prenese med smerema.

Teren je za ta prostor in ta dan sprejel, da Vale začne, ter Seli dal pooblastilo ustaviti skrajšani Valejev premor. Sela je po obratu sprejela Orrino celotno imenovanje ter Terenu dala pooblastilo ustaviti pas brez priče. Oba sta ohranila pravico oditi.
Podpisa nista zavezovala starešine Ivena ali starešine More. Njuna zunanja obreda sta se že zbirala.

Ob 09:14 so vajenci pritisnili prvo hladilno zagozdo, medtem ko je Illuminara držala obroč naravnost. Sedla je: štirideset minut pod polno obremenitvijo za sedemindvajsetminutni obred. Jori je drugo zagozdo odnesel k zapahu na polovici.
Vrata dvorane so se odprla. Ljudje so izbrali, kje bodo stali.

scenes.title: Praznik dveh težnosti
paragraphs: *Skupna dvorana · 09:20 · prva zagozda nameščena; zagozda na polovici še čaka*

Prazen prostor je bil z motorjem obrnjen navzdol po Valejevo. Vale je vstopil z modrimi zvonovi, katerih kaplje so počivale tam, kjer je dom rekel navzdol. Pasovi, ki so žalujoče dvigovali v napačni težnosti, so zdaj pod njihovimi stopali držali shranjeno vleko bobna. Orra je čakala z rokami na prvem neobremenjenem pladnju. Illuminara je čepela pod ranjenim obročem; Jori je držal drugo zagozdo; Teren in Sela sta držala vsak svojo zavoro.

**Sela Varo**  
Eran Vale, ki je odstopil svoje mesto v zadnji spuščalni kletki.

**Valejevi žalujoči**  
Padel si onkraj naših tal. Za teboj obračamo obraze.
Tri imena. Sedem vdihov. Ob zadnjem vdihu je Orra, potem ko se je pas nehal tresti, v skupni pladenj brez besed dodala en izmerjeni disk. Vsaka modra kaplja je zazvonila ob pravi steni.
Ob razpokani plošči je Sela izgovorila vseh osemnajst imen pogrešanih. Teren je držal eno roko na zavori in drugo ob steklu, da polovici ne bi rožljali.
Po zadnjem Valejevem imenu je Jori sprostil sklopljeni obremenitvi. Dvorana je začela svoj edini polobrat. Tla in strop niso bile več poštene besede.

Štiri sekunde so kaplje lebdele v središčih zvonov, železni diski pa so se za prst dvignili nad pladnje. Nemi se je zasmejala. Illuminara je občutila odzivno radost — nenadno, telesno in takšno, da je ni bilo mogoče zamenjati za nespoštovanje. Tudi Teren se je zasmejal.
Sela je ujela Lioin pladenj, ko se je pod njimi zbirala Orrina težnost. Dva Valejeva žalujoča sta ga držala z njo. Teren je sprostil zavoro šele, ko so vsi pasovi pokazali zeleno.

**Teren Oss**  
Hessa Pell, ki je držala tlačna vrata Severnega kraka odprta.

**Orrini žalujoči**  
Teža te je držala. Mi ohranjamo tvojo težo.
Štiri imena. Trije vdihi. Med vsakim premorom so Valejeve priče v tišini preverile vrvi.

**Teren Oss**  
Lio Oss, ki je splezala na zunanje lopatice, ker se zasilni motor ni odzval.

**Orrini žalujoči**  
Teža te je držala. Mi ohranjamo tvojo težo.

**Nemi**  
Lio.
Ime je prečkalo dvorano v Lioini pravi smeri. Sela je držala roko na pladnju, dokler se ni nehal tresti.
Pri zapahu na polovici je druga zagozda zdrsnila ob manjkajočem zobu.

**Jori Nemet**  
Mirovanje za dva vdiha.
Teren je zaprl zavoro. Sela je vsem Valejevim pričam naročila, naj držijo. Illuminara je torzijo prevzela v ramo. Jori je zagozdo obrnil, enkrat udaril in jo zaklenil. Toplotna črta se je ustavila.
Zunaj sta iz ločenih dvorišč odgovorila Morin kamniti boben in Ivenov nebesni zvon. Njuna obreda sta se nadaljevala brez obsojanja od znotraj.

Zadnje Orrino ime je bilo izgovorjeno ob 09:47. Vsako skupno ime je bilo izgovorjeno enkrat, v pravi usmeritvi svoje skupnosti. Med polobratom so roke druge skupnosti varno prenesle njegove zvonove ali pladnje v naslednjo smer.

scenes.title: Kar ohrani dvorana
paragraphs: *Dvorišči Hiše obrata · 10:31 · os se hladi*
Dvorana se je zaprla zaradi popravila, vendar se njene stene niso pretrgale. Razpokana plošča je ležala med oblazinjenimi oporami in vseh osemnajst imen je ostalo čitljivih.

**Sela Varo**  
Pustite razpoko.

**Teren Oss**  
Označite, zakaj je počila — in kdo je ugovarjal pred preizkusom.

**Jori Nemet**  
Bom.

Listina o popravilu je vsaki skupnosti dala lastne krmilnike obremenitve in zavoro za ustavitev. Noben ključ ni mogel sam zavrteti dvorane. Za naslednje leto ni določila vrstnega reda in ni mogla preprečiti nobenega zunanjega obreda.

Na drugi strani dvorišča je Iven izlil vodo iz svojega zvona v korito. Mora je disk svojega sina postavila v kamnito nišo. Skupno dvorano sta zavrnila in ohranila svoja obreda. Pozneje je vsak poslal po enega vajenca v Jorijev razred o osi; nobeden ni podprl praznika.
Nemi in dva Valejeva otroka so skozi lesen obroč napeljali vrvi. Ko so vsi hkrati potegnili, se je zagozdil. Ko so prisluhnili premorom, se je obrnil.

**Nemi**  
To ni ista pesem.

**Valejev otrok**  
Saj ne bi smela biti.
Obrnili so ga še enkrat. Vale je začel, ne da bi mu dodelili zadnje mesto. Orra je svoje mrtve imenovala v pravi smeri navzdol proti obroču. Spor je ostal, razpoka je ostala in skupna os je ostala.
Jori je oba zavorna ključa zaklenil v ločeni škatli ter enega dal Seli, drugega pa Terenu.

translation_sl.critic_line: Skupnosti, ki sta vsaka potrebovali, da bi bila ura druge napačna, sta spoznali, da se prostor lahko obrne, če se njuna vleka sestavita namesto razvrstita; Illuminara, ki je v Valejevi težnosti držala Orrin disk, da bi občutila napačnost, pa je prevzela odgovornost za skrajšani preizkus, ki je počil zob in ploščo, zato se je Teren odločil, da Vale začne, Sela je med obratom položila roko na Lioin pladenj, dva ključa pa sta končala v dveh škatlah.
